mapper.select: select card_image.id, user.name as user_name, card_image.url, label.name as label, card_image.like_count as like_count, card_image.comment_count as comment_count from card_image left join label on card_image.label_id = label.id left join user on card_image.user_id = user.id where card_image.id = #{cardId};
